threads.body: This conversion passes `NodeWithScore.score` through without filtering non-finite floats, unlike the LangChain conversion. If a retriever returns `NaN` or ±`Inf`, `gen_ai_json_dumps` emits non-standard `NaN`/`Infinity` tokens, so `gen_ai.retrieval.documents` is not valid JSON for consumers of the shared model; normalize such scores to `None` and add a regression test.

threads.body: This conversion used to guard `node_id` and `score` access with `except BaseException`, so a malformed/custom `NodeWithScore` could not make telemetry break the retrieval call. These direct property accesses now run from `prepare_to_exit_span` without a guard; if either accessor raises, span finalization raises into LlamaIndex after the underlying retrieval has succeeded. Keep the extraction guarded and skip only the malformed document to preserve the instrumentation's transparent return/error behavior.
